## Full GEOGRAPHY polygons
# Source: BigQuery answers for full polygon spelling, measurements and constructor boundaries.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe')
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(' FULLGLOBE ')
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "0"

SELECT ST_AREA(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "5.100660731179886E14"

# The documentation describes distances between vertices, but BigQuery returns the distance
# to the antipode for a full polygon, which has no vertices (ST_NUMPOINTS above).
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> "2.001511821194711E7"

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "2.001511821194711E7"

SELECT ST_EXTERIORRING(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "{ \"type\": \"Polygon\", \"coordinates\": [ [ [180, 90], [-180, 90], [-180, -90], [180, -90], [180, 90] ] ] } "

SELECT ST_DUMP(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> [{"v":"GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"}]

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(fullglobe, POINT(1 2))')
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY'), [ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0)')])
=> "POLYGON((0 2, 2 0, 0 0, 0 2))"

SELECT ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY'), [ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY')])
=> error: ST_MakePolygon failed: Polygon holes cannot be empty/full loops.

SELECT ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0)'), [ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY')])
=> error: ST_MakePolygon failed: Polygon holes cannot be empty/full loops.

SELECT ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY'), [ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(10 0, 12 0, 10 2, 10 0)')])
=> "POLYGON((0 2, 2 0, 0 0, 0 2), (10 2, 12 0, 10 0, 10 2))"

SELECT ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY'), [ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 4 0, 0 4, 0 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 1 2, 1 1)')])
=> error: ST_MakePolygon failed: Polygon should have only one shell, holes must be inside the shell. Polygon hole 2 is outside of the shell

# The union of eight spherical octants covers the sphere.
SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_UNION([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 90 0, 0 90, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((90 0, 180 0, 0 90, 90 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((180 0, -90 0, 0 90, 180 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((-90 0, 0 0, 0 90, -90 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 90 0, 0 -90, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((90 0, 180 0, 0 -90, 90 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((180 0, -90 0, 0 -90, 180 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((-90 0, 0 0, 0 -90, -90 0))')]), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "true"

# Source: the documented accessor, measurement and point set semantics, including that only
# the full polygon is closed and that the full polygon has no interior rings.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md

SELECT ST_ISCLOSED(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISEMPTY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISCOLLECTION(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_NUMGEOMETRIES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "1"

SELECT ST_GEOMETRYTYPE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "ST_Polygon"

SELECT ST_DIMENSION(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "2"

SELECT ST_INTERIORRINGS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> []

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_PERIMETER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 90))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_COVERS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_WITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_CONTAINS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_TOUCHES(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0))'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 0))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, -90), 0)
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, -90), -1)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_UNION(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_UNION([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)')]), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(ST_ASTEXT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_UNION(ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY'), [ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0)')]), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 2 0, 0 2, 0 0))')), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "true"
